outcome: microbial community composition and diversity (alpha and beta diversity)
cohort: Seventeen maternal-twin dyads (MTDs) from whom meconium, placenta, and maternal buccal, skin, vaginal, and stool samples were collected at delivery.
finding: The fetal gut microbiome (via meconium) is distinct from the placenta and various maternal microbiomes, and placentas within the same twin dyad also exhibit distinct microbiomes.
